COX-2 inhibition is relatively selective with celecoxib.
Analgesic activity results from reduced prostaglandin production.
Cardiovascular risk remains relevant despite COX-2 selectivity.
Renal adverse effects remain possible, as with other NSAIDs.

title: Danis Weber Classification of Malleolar Fractures of The Ankle

notes.text: Danis-Weber classification
A concise, newly authored revision guide for this topic. Use the video for the instructor’s full explanation; these notes do not claim to transcribe it.
Type A fibular fractures are below the syndesmosis.
Type B fractures are at the syndesmotic level.
Type C fractures are above the syndesmosis.
Medial injury and syndesmotic stability affect management beyond the classification letter.

Articular depression can impair joint congruity.
Bicondylar injury involves both medial and lateral plateaus.
Soft tissue condition is important in planning fixation.

A concise, newly authored revision guide for this topic. Use the video for the instructor’s full explanation; these notes do not claim to transcribe it.
Absorbable sutures lose tensile strength and are broken down over time.
Monofilament sutures consist of a single strand.
Cutting needles are suited to penetrating tougher tissues such as skin.
Taper-point needles separate rather than cut tissue and are used in many softer tissues.
Needle control depends on appropriate instrument grip and controlled passage through tissue.

Severity assessment includes organ failure and complications rather than a score alone.

Alvarado score combines clinical features and laboratory findings to support risk assessment.
Imaging and clinical reassessment help resolve diagnostic uncertainty.

title: Approach to Acute Coronary Syndromes: Clinical Presentation, Diagnosis and Treatment

notes.text: Acute coronary syndromes
A concise, newly authored revision guide for this topic. Use the video for the instructor’s full explanation; these notes do not claim to transcribe it.
Myocardial ischemia occurs when oxygen supply is insufficient for myocardial demand.
ECG is an early essential investigation in suspected acute coronary syndrome.
Troponin indicates myocardial injury but must be interpreted with clinical evidence.
Reperfusion is time-critical for eligible patients with acute coronary occlusion.

notes.text: Septic arthritis
A concise, newly authored revision guide for this topic. Use the video for the instructor’s full explanation; these notes do not claim to transcribe it.
Joint infection can rapidly damage articular cartilage.
Synovial fluid analysis is central to evaluation when joint infection is suspected.
Kocher criteria estimate likelihood in selected pediatric hip presentations but are not definitive.
Drainage and appropriate antimicrobial therapy are important treatment principles.
